entities.summary: Sevuloni Lasei Reece is a Fijian born New Zealand rugby union player who plays as a wing for the Crusaders in Super Rugby and Southland in the Bunnings NPC. Born in Fiji, he represents New Zealand at international level after qualifying on residency grounds. He is the highest try scorer in Super Rugby with 70 tries.
